name: Stripe Payout to Bank Reconciliation — aggregated deposit splitting

parameters.formDescription: Upload the platform export (Stripe/PayPal transactions) and the bank statement. You get back a sheet with three tabs: Reconciled, Pending, Differences.

parameters.content:
## The node that matters: deposit disaggregation

Stripe/PayPal deposit a net that bundles N transactions minus fees and refunds. Reconcile opens each bank deposit against the settlement batch that composes it, matching in three tiers (exact reference, amount in +-3d window, cent tolerance). Tolerances are CONFIG at the top of the code — nothing is reconciled by approximation without recording the criterion used.
